title: The Course FAQ Answerer
description: Grounded on a syllabus and course documents; answers student logistics questions and refers back to the human instructor when the answer isn't in the sources.
framing_paragraph: This recipe defines The Course FAQ Answerer, a teaching-focused agent that fits the use case in the description above. Use it when that description matches what you want the agent to do in your course. The agent works best when its Instructions field is calibrated against two or three representative prompts before you share the resulting agent with students or colleagues.

recommended_platforms.comparative_phrase: similar performance on Gemini (custom Gem) and Claude (Projects), advanced on Copilot Studio for faculty with tenant access
recommended_platforms.tradeoff_subline: Custom GPTs and Gemini Gems both support file grounding and shareable links. Copilot Studio offers stronger institutional integration but requires Pamplin tenant access (most faculty would coordinate with Jim Dickhans). NotebookLM is a lightweight alternative.
